criteria.statement: A thread-safe pressure monitor records the latest worker pressure snapshot and ignores observations older than the stored LastAdvertisementAt.
The pressure monitor reports changed=true only when a stored worker capacity class transitions to a different class.
Worker state publication is reusable outside Reactor and includes telemetry and pressure content fields with filtering tags for capacity_class, pressure_state, and recommended_action.
App wiring reacts to EventWorkerTelemetryObserved by observing pressure, emitting EventWorkerPressureChanged for transitions, and republishing worker state.
